title: MDV axis specification
description: SPEC 7.3. There is no second value axis (SPEC 7.3.1).

grid.description: Hairline, solid, never dashed (SPEC 11.4). Default y: true, x: false.

ticks.description: A count hint; the generator prefers round values.

tickRotate.description: Degrees. Layout auto-rotates to -45 only on collision, and MUST NOT clip.
